final.duration_caution: Per-hero seconds are tick-start counters. No gain means HP did not rise, including flat full HP; stationary requires <=1e-6 model-unit movement. Death/respawn/max-HP changes reset episodes. Cumulative retreat is not a continuous episode and can be useful travel or defensive holding. These metrics are not automatic working-solution failures.
final.duration_row_unit: 400 evaluated-team legs × five evaluated-team hero roles = 2000 rows; not both teams' ten heroes per leg.
final.latency_caution: Main includes SDK legal-list adapter conversion; final uses raw directly. Local CPU/wall decide timing is not network latency or a clean policy-only performance comparison.
final.weak_control_limits: Explicit idle, input-order first-legal, and uniform current macros+idle are defensible controls; they are not a representative population of arbitrary unstrategic humans.
